cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.

mechanism: A coaches its hosting pupil through the consequences of putting cake on a spare chair until B solution requires A to surrender its own seat.
confusable: Not an arbitrary final obstacle: cake, chair and displaced guest return as a concrete chain ending in the mentor standing.
comparison: Wet invitation erases address versus cake consumes spare seating.
